defective_pattern: Fixing prose style only in isolated paragraphs flagged by the user while leaving the remaining sections in an unrefined, mechanical state.
why_defective: Creates stylistic inconsistency, tonal dissonance, and abrupt shifts in writing maturity across consecutive sections.
observed_symptoms: One polished section followed by sections with mechanical listicles and hanging colons
Haphazard tense switching across different chapter parts
corrective_remedy: When an academic tone issue is flagged, conduct a global chapter-wide sweep to apply the validated scholarly standard across all sections uniformly.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of localized paragraph rewrites while sister paragraphs retain legacy non-compliant formatting or tone.
